name: Globe Multi Ventures Limited
about: Globe Multi Ventures Limited engages in the processing, marketing, selling, distribution, and trading of agri commodities in India. It offers pulses, cereals, corn, wheat, rice, etc.; and provides e-commerce solutions. The company was formerly known as Globe Commercials Limited and changed its name to Globe Multi Ventures Limited in September 2021. Globe Multi Ventures Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Secunderabad, India.
